toegepas.rede_vinder: Commas around the example keep a Grade 5 reader from parsing "'n bergrug skei" as the subject and verb, and make the main clause easier to follow.
toegepas.fout: Without commas a Grade 5 reader can parse "'n bergrug skei" as its own subject and verb and stumble on the first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Commas set off the example so the main clause reads cleanly; meaning unchanged and the protected 'so 'n bergrug' in the next sentence is untouched.

laat_vaar.voor: Reën aan die een kant van so
laat_vaar.na: Reënwater aan die een kant van so
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: It is the rainwater that runs off to a river, not the rain itself; this also matches "reënwater" earlier in the block.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Reën ... loop' is natural Afrikaans, and changing only the first half breaks the parallel with 'reën aan die ander kant' in the same sentence.

vlae.teks: Aan die einde van sy pad kom 'n rivier by sy mond.
vlae.rede: Read alone this says every river reaches a mouth, while the next two sentences say only most do and some end in a marsh or dry pan; a writer may want to soften it, which is a content decision, not a language one.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat verder af tot 'n rivier groei
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat laer af tot 'n rivier groei
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Laer af' says clearly that the stream grows lower down the slope; 'verder af' is vague.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Verder af' is natural Afrikaans for further along the course, and 'laer af' narrows it to height only, so it is lateral with a slight shift.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: vloei byvoorbeeld wes na die Atlantiese Oseaan
laat_vaar_vorige.na: vloei byvoorbeeld weswaarts na die Atlantiese Oseaan
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Weswaarts' is the natural adverb of direction with 'vloei ... na'; bare 'wes' reads clipped.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die rivier vloei wes' is normal Afrikaans; 'weswaarts' only reads differently and adds a longer word for a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: kry 'n rivier ekstra water uit kleiner riviere
laat_vaar_vorige.na: kry 'n rivier ekstra water van kleiner riviere
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: With 'kry' (receive) the idiomatic preposition is 'van', not 'uit'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Water uit kleiner riviere kry' is correct and means the same as 'van' (water comes from the tributaries), so the preposition swap is a lateral move.
